agent_notes: Normal TLS verification initially failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs to the expected NIRF and tmu.ac.in hosts used curl --insecure fallback.
All six supplied 2025 NIRF pages contain the exact institution name with Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh.

The central JSON catalogue exposes 116 programmes, while the official sitemap exposes 130 programme detail URLs; two sitemap pages are explicitly marked offered till 2023-2024 and were excluded, leaving 128 current-looking programme pages. The mismatch and absence of a central Ph.D./certificate listing make the catalogue incomplete/inconsistent, so manual_review is required.

News and blog pages were excluded from the programme inventory; durations were retained only where the official programme page explicitly displayed them, and eligibility was left null because it was not taken from the central catalogue.
Delivery mode is not stated by the central catalogue; mode is recorded as not_specified.

The context labels the institution_type as state_university, while the official homepage describes TMU as a private university; this classification discrepancy is noted without changing the supplied institution identity.
career_path.db was queried read-only; direct discipline nodes were preferred and nearest-parent or closest-specialization relations were used for variants without an exact local-tree node.
